ambient_events: The charge is taped, tagged, and dated in a hand that has done this many times.
Chalk arrows on the wall point one way only: out.
The drain hatch below is barred from this side, and the bar is bright with use.
description: A short raw-cut passage ending at a barred drain hatch, with a charge and a keyed collapse rigged into the roof beams above the halfway point. If the Watch are ever found, this corridor becomes forty tonnes of fill and the base becomes a hole in somebody's map. It is swept weekly and walked daily. The people who use it call the walk-through 'reading the ceiling'.
name: The Deadfall
